verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a REST API (tax estimate endpoint POST /v1/tax/estimate) plus SDKs for real-time tax pricing before payment, and product categorization drives jurisdiction-specific taxation — supporting the core 'calculate tax via API' story. However, there is no explicit evidence of address-level (rooftop) precision versus ZIP-level approximation, and no documented latency/performance benchmarks confirming it's fast enough for checkout. missing for 10: explicit rooftop/address-level accuracy claims, latency/performance guarantees for checkout-speed use, independent verification of calculation accuracy.
